zh.summary: 新增官方 0.2.1-alpha.5 内核；第一次启动和内核更新更快，等待时会说明原因。
highlights: 内核：新增可选内核 0.2.1-alpha.5（官方最新测试版）；可选内核保留最新三个，并始终包含最新的 RC 版 0.2.0-rc.2。预装的图片查看器升到 0.1.12、会话管理升到 1.5.13，都已适配 alpha.5。
第一次启动更快：计算依赖关系时不再重复探测目录，在模拟的低性能电脑上第一次启动约快三分之一（约 18 秒降到 12 到 13 秒）；电脑较慢时解压改为更省 CPU 的写入方式，较快的电脑保持原样。
内核更新更省：同样内容的文件只写一份，其余用硬链接指向它。官方 alpha 内核包里有七成文件是重复的，解压时间少约两成到三成，解压后少占约 180 MB 磁盘。不支持硬链接的磁盘会自动改成直接写入。
等待有说明：启动画面在解压阶段会说明“首次启动只需展开一次，之后会快很多”，任何一步超过 8 秒会显示已等待的秒数，不再让人以为卡住。
upgradeNotes: 升级会保留设置、会话、插件和默认工作区。整包更新后会自动恢复你选的内核。
升级后的第一次启动仍要展开一次运行文件；这次它更快，并且会显示为什么需要等。

en.summary: Adds the official 0.2.1-alpha.5 core; the first start and core updates are faster, and waits now explain themselves.
highlights: Cores: adds the selectable core 0.2.1-alpha.5 (the latest official test build); the list keeps the newest three and always includes the newest RC, 0.2.0-rc.2. The preinstalled Image Viewer is now 0.1.12 and Chat Manager 1.5.13, both adapted to alpha.5.

Faster first start: working out the dependency graph no longer probes the same directories over and over, which makes the first start about a third faster on an emulated low-power PC (about 18 s down to 12-13 s); on slow PCs the unpacking uses a lighter write path, faster PCs are unchanged.

Lighter core updates: files with identical contents are written once and hard-linked. About 70% of the files in the official alpha core package are duplicates, so unpacking takes roughly 20-30% less time and about 180 MB less disk. Disks without hard-link support fall back to plain writes automatically.

Waits explain themselves: while unpacking, the start screen says it only happens once and later starts are much faster, and any step that takes over 8 s shows the elapsed seconds, so it no longer looks stuck.
upgradeNotes: Upgrading keeps settings, sessions, plugins, and the default workspace. After a full update your chosen core is restored automatically.
The first start after upgrading still unpacks the runtime once; it is faster now and tells you why it waits.
